name: secdeva/fieldTypes/deliveryModel

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We develop it and place it on the market
enumValues.enumDescription: We develop this product ourselves and place it on the market under our own name, which makes us its manufacturer.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We deliver it (already on the market)
enumValues.enumDescription: We include a product that is already available on the market

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We import it into the market and deliver it
enumValues.enumDescription: We are the first to place this product on the market, from a manufacturer established outside the market.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We deliver it under our own name, or substantially modified
enumValues.enumDescription: Placing a product on the market under your own name or trademark, or modifying it substantially, makes you its manufacturer.
We depend on it but never ship it. Part of the environment rather than of the delivery.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We use it to operate a service
enumValues.enumDescription: We run it ourselves, on infrastructure we are responsible for, rather than shipping it to anyone, so it is not placed on the market.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We consume it as a service
enumValues.enumDescription: A third party operates it and we use it over the network, such as a managed database, an identity provider or a payment API. We depend on it but never run or ship it, so it is not placed on the market.

description: What we actually do with this product, including who is responsible for operating it. Determines the planned supply chain role.
